moves.label: Trade: Malik Beasley, D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Damian Jones, Juan Toscano-Anderson and others
moves.description: Malik Beasley, D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Damian Jones, Juan Toscano-Anderson, Russell Westbrook, a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick and a conditional 2027 1st round pick (LAL own). Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Mike Conley, a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a 2025 2nd round pick (UTH own), a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own) and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for D'Angelo Russell. Damian Jones, Juan Toscano-Anderson, Russell Westbrook, a conditional 2027 1st round pick (LAL own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Utah Jazz in exchange for Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Malik Beasley, Mike Conley, Jarred Vanderbilt, a 2025 2nd round pick (UTH own) and a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own).

moves.label: Trade: Buddy Hield, Klay Thompson, Josh Green, Kyle Anderson, Buddy Hield and others
moves.description: A 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) was acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Buddy Hield. Klay Thompson and a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for Josh Green and a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own). Kyle Anderson and Buddy Hield were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Klay Thompson, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. Josh Green, Reggie Jackson, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own) were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for a 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash. A 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own), cash and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Reggie Jackson, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own). A Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Kyle Anderson.

moves.label: Trade: Ulrich Chomche, Cam Spencer, Ulrich Chomche, Wendell Moore, Jr., Bobi Klintman and others
moves.description: The draft rights to Ulrich Chomche was acquired by the Toronto Raptors in exchange for cash. The draft rights to Cam Spencer was acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for the draft rights to Ulrich Chomche and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (MEM own). Wendell Moore, Jr. and the draft rights to Bobi Klintman were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for the draft rights to Cam Spencer. A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (MEM own), cash and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Wendell Moore, Jr. and the draft rights to Bobi Klintman.

moves.label: Trade: Karl-Anthony Towns, James Nnaji, Keita Bates-Diop, Charlie Brown, Jr., Donte DiVincenzo and others
moves.description: Karl-Anthony Towns and the draft rights to James Nnaji were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Keita Bates-Diop, Charlie Brown, Jr., Donte DiVincenzo, DaQuan Jeffries, Julius Randle, Duane Washington, Jr., a conditional 2023 1st round pick (DET own), a 2026 2nd round pick (GOS own), a 2031 2nd round pick (NYK own) and cash. Keita Bates-Diop, Donte DiVincenzo, Julius Randle, a conditional 2023 1st round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Karl-Anthony Towns and a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick. Charlie Brown, Jr., DaQuan Jeffries, Duane Washington, Jr., a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (GOS own), a 2031 2nd round pick (NYK own) and cash were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for the draft rights to James Nnaji.

moves.label: Trade: Adou Thiero, Adou Thiero, Rocco Zikarsky, Jahmai Mashack, Alex Toohey and others
moves.description: A 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own) was acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for the draft rights to Adou Thiero and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks. The draft rights to Adou Thiero was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky and cash. The draft rights to Jahmai Mashack and the draft rights to Alex Toohey were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for the draft rights to Koby Brea. Clint Capela, Kevin Durant and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, the draft rights to Jahmai Mashack, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash. A Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for Clint Capela. The draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick and cash were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming. Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Koby Brea, the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Kevin Durant, the draft rights to Alex Toohey, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick.
